Longhorn Steakhouse Happy Hour Menu and Specials

Discover Longhorn Steakhouse: A Cut Above the Rest

Longhorn Steakhouse is a premier steak restaurant in the United States, known for its casual dining atmosphere and expertly grilled steaks. Whether you’re planning a lunch or dinner outing, this steakhouse offers something for everyone. If you are looking for affordable indulgence during happy hour, this detailed guide on the Longhorn Steakhouse happy hour menu will help you plan your next visit.

What Is Happy Hour at Longhorn Steakhouse?

Happy hour at Longhorn Steakhouse is a promotional period when guests can enjoy select food and drinks at discounted prices. Typically running from 4 PM to 7 PM on weekdays, it’s a perfect opportunity to sample the menu features without spending a fortune.

Longhorn Steakhouse Happy Hour Times

The happy hour times are consistent across most restaurant locations. Here is a breakdown of the general hours:

Day Happy Hour Time
Monday 4 PM to 7 PM
Tuesday 4 PM to 7 PM
Wednesday 4 PM to 7 PM
Thursday 4 PM to 7 PM
Friday 4 PM to 7 PM

Note: These times may vary slightly depending on the restaurant located near you. It is recommended to check the Longhorn Steakhouse website or call ahead to your restaurant located near you.

Happy Hour Specials: Bite into the Best Deals

The happy hour specials at Longhorn combine appetizer excellence with affordable drink specials. The prime time menu caters to all kinds of taste buds:

  • Spicy yet flavorful crispy jalapeño shooters
  • Classic comfort food like prime-time chili cheese fries
  • Creative drinks like the cucumber mint mojito

Steak and More: What Makes Longhorn a Top Steakhouse

Longhorn is more than just happy hour drinks. Their main draw remains the steak, with the kitchen promising steaks done right every time. Every steak is seasoned with a signature spice blend, ensuring that the flavors are bold and authentic.

Seasonal Sides and Signature Desserts

Your happy hour experience can be extended with seasonal sides and signature desserts, like:

  • Freshly baked bread with honey butter
  • Seasonal veggies
  • Chocolate stampede cake
  • Cheesecake with strawberry drizzle

Visit the Longhorn Steakhouse Restaurant Near You

Whether you are in Texas, Florida, or New York, you can visit the Longhorn Steakhouse and enjoy their happy hour menu. For those wondering about happy hour near them, using restaurant locators on the official site can direct you to the closest Longhorn Steakhouse restaurant.

Why Choose Longhorn Steakhouse Happy Hour?

Longhorn Steakhouse’s happy hour is tailored to provide a delicious dining experience at a price point that’s hard to beat. Here’s why you should visit the Longhorn Steakhouse restaurant:

  • High-quality steak cuts at discounted prices
  • Creative cocktail options
  • Cozy, casual dining ambiance
  • Diverse menu features from shrimp to fry sides
  • Available pm on weekdays for convenience

Drinks at Longhorn Steakhouse: What to Expect

Their happy hour drinks list is extensive. Alongside the classic steakhouse martini, enjoy:

  • Prime time margarita
  • Seasonal glass of house wine
  • Draft beer by the pint

Longhorn Happy Hour vs. Other Steak Restaurants

If you’re comparing Longhorn happy hour to other steakhouse giants like Outback Steakhouse, you’ll notice a distinct edge in quality and pricing. Longhorn offers a more refined yet relaxed experience, giving value with every dish.

Happy Hour Deals: A Closer Look

The happy hour deals at Longhorn are crafted with variety in mind. Whether you’re into spicy bites or smooth cocktails, the food and drinks selection has something you’ll crave.

Lunch or Dinner: Flexible Scheduling

Can’t make it during happy hour? No worries. Longhorn’s menu remains accessible all day with premium cuts, sides, and beverages for a hearty lunch or dinner.

Guests Can Enjoy More

With a menu that changes seasonally, guests can enjoy new items frequently.

That’s a Cut: Longhorn’s Brand Motto

When Longhorn says “that’s a cut above the rest,” they mean it. Their reputation for excellent steaks and customer service reinforces why they’re a leader in steak restaurant dining.

Want to explore more top-rated happy hour deals on food and drinks? Check out our full Eatery Happy Hour Guide for the best specials in Des Moines, NYC, and beyond.

Frequently Asked Questions

Is the Happy Hour Menu Available on Weekends?

Generally, happy hour is limited to weekdays (Monday through Friday). However, some locations may offer weekend specials.

Do Prices Vary by Location?

Yes, prices and offerings may slightly differ depending on the restaurant located near you.

Can I Access the Happy Hour Menu Online?

Yes, the full happy hour menu with prices is often available on the official Longhorn Steakhouse website.

Are There Non-Alcoholic Options?

Yes. In addition to cocktails, you can order beverages like sodas, lemonades, and iced teas during happy hour.

Experience Steaks Done Right: Visit Longhorn

Don’t miss your chance to indulge in Longhorn Steakhouse’s happy hour . Whether it’s a bite of their spicy chicken bites or a sip of their classic steakhouse martini, the experience is designed for steak lovers and casual diners alike.
